name: dappercode-workspace
description: DapperCode desktop and mobile development workspace

scripts.bridge: BRIDGE_WORKDIR=$(pwd) pnpm run cargo run --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml
scripts.desktop:test: pnpm run cargo test --locked --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1 && node ./scripts/test-desktop-macos.mjs
scripts.duplicates:check: pnpm run duplicates:mobile && pnpm run duplicates:native
scripts.contract:check: pnpm run agui:check && node scripts/validate-rpc-contract-fixtures.mjs && pnpm --filter @dappercode/mobile run test:contract && pnpm run cargo test --locked --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml contract_fixture_manifest
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @dappercode/mobile run build && pnpm run cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml && pnpm run cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @dappercode/mobile run typecheck && pnpm run typecheck:scripts && pnpm run typecheck:e2e && pnpm run cargo check --locked --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml && pnpm run cargo check --locked --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml
scripts.lint: pnpm run format:check && pnpm --filter @dappercode/mobile run lint && pnpm run duplicates:check && pnpm run cargo fmt --check --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml && pnpm run cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --all-features --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings && pnpm run cargo fmt --check --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml && pnpm run cargo clippy --locked --all-targets --manifest-path apps/desktop/Cargo.toml -- -D warnings
scripts.test: pnpm run test:scripts && pnpm --filter @dappercode/mobile run test && pnpm run cargo test --locked --manifest-path services/rust-bridge/Cargo.toml -- --test-threads=1 && pnpm run desktop:test
